Name: Guildmaster Marlen - Genderswap Marlon NPC
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
Description:
This mod reimagines Marlon as Marlen, a grizzled, one-armed swordswoman with mouth full of gravel. Marlen will push you away with a snarl, but once you've earned her trust, she'll fight like hell to keep you safe.

[size=6][b]L[/b][/size][size=5][b]atest Update[/b][/size]
Added dialogue compatibility for: [i][b]Sunberry Village[/b][/i], [i][b]Sword and Sorcery[/b][/i], [i][b]Befriend Marlon and Gunther[/b][/i], and [i][b]Marnie x Marlon[/b][/i] (please read the "Special Mod Interaction" section for [i]MxM[/i] specifically)

[b][color=#dd7e6b][size=6]S[/size][size=5]pecial Mod Interaction[/size][/color][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7018][i]Make Marlon Real[/i][/url]
You'll need to have this mod installed if you want Marlen to be a real, social NPC. It adds a lot more dialogue beyond what [i]MMR[/i] provides, and further polishes things so [i]MMR[/i] can function on its own. [b][i]Make Gil Real[/i][/b] is not required, though it would flesh out the Guild's full history.

Her heart event progression has also been restructured, allowing her to reach full hearts either as a friend or a romantic partner. Just give her a bouquet any time after her 8-heart event.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][i]Stardew Valley Expanded[/i][/url]
With SVE installed, Marlen becomes a separate character from Marlon, each with their own distinct storylines. You could interpret them as twins or something similar. Adjustments have been made so you'd at least not get visual errors if you also have [b][i]Make Marlon Real[/i] [/b]installed.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34255][i]Marnie x Marlon[/i][/url]
The mod page lists [b][i]Befriend Marlon and Gunther[/i][/b], [b][i]Make Marlon Real[/i][/b], or [b][i]Stardew Valley Expanded[/i][/b] as requirements. If you have [b][i]Guildmaster Marlen[/i][/b] installed, none of those mods are required anymore.

You can still install [i]Befriend Marlon and Gunther[/i] or [i]MMR[/i] if you wish, although [i]MMR[/i]'s story will conflict with [i]Marnie x Marlon[/i]. If you have [i]SVE[/i] installed, however, Marlon Fay will court Marnie instead of Marlen.

[b][color=#ffe599][size=6]M[/size][/color][size=5][color=#ffe599]ods Support[/color][/size]
[i]Guildmaster Marlen[/i][/b] isn’t simply Marlon under a different name. She has her own distinct personality, which requires custom dialogue edits. Mods not listed should still work with no problem; Marlen would just speak a little out of character.
